productLine: LumiShine Repair+ Dimensional Deposit Demi-Permanent Crème Color
source: Joico LumiShine Repair+ Dimensional Deposit technical data sheet

numbering_system.description: Joico LumiShine Dimensional Deposit uses a simplified shade range from the standard LumiShine numbering system. Focused on deposit-only application with fewer tonal variations.

lines.name: LumiShine Repair+ Dimensional Deposit Demi-Permanent Crème Color
lines.description: Ammonia-free demi-permanent crème color. Can go light to dark in one step without pre-pigmentation. Grey blending on level 6+, grey coverage on level 5 and darker. ArgiPlex and Quadramine Complex technology.

6_vol.use: Gentle deposit, grey blending, sensitive scalp

gray_coverage.rule: Grey blending on level 6 and lighter; grey coverage on level 5 and darker
gray_coverage.blending: Subtle grey blending without full coverage on lighter levels
gray_coverage.coverage: Full grey coverage on level 5 and darker shades
gray_coverage.recommended: Use NN (Double Natural) or N (Natural) shades for best grey results

use_cases.deposit_only: Deposit color without lift — can go light to dark in one step
use_cases.grey_coverage: Full coverage on level 5 and darker without pre-pigmentation
use_cases.grey_blending: Blend grey on level 6 and lighter
use_cases.toning: Add tone and dimension to pre-lightened or natural hair

processing_times.deeper_penetration: Up to 25 minutes for resistant hair or grey coverage

formulation_guidelines.dimensional_deposit_note: Simplified shade range designed for deposit-only services. Can go light to dark without pre-pigmentation.
